name: gg-corporate-tax-substance
description: Prepare calendar-year 2026 corporate tax classification and compliance working papers. This draft does not calculate Pillar Two, regulated-sector special rules, exemption applications or every company-law obligation. This source-cited draft supports preparation of reviewable working papers using the stated periods, evidence requirements and computation examples. Retain source evidence and effective dates; unresolved points and professional review remain explicit. Use the linked official materials when checking a case, and obtain a qualified local review before filing or making a payment. Read the explicit exclusions before applying its calculations to different facts.
